notes: Owner specification-review ruling of 2026-08-31, which approved this missing composition proposition and specified its content. Measured at the common `rejection` / `response_rejection` boundary and its call-site totality, as the ruling directed, rather than by duplicating each refusal reason — a battery enumerating causes would have to learn about the next one, and a stale enumeration passes cleanly over an unrecorded refusal. The ordering conjunct is included because recording after the mint leaves a window in which a refusal has been served and no record of it exists.
